title: Oakcliff Sailing

services.name: Programs
services.desc: The Winter and Summer Sapling programs are 3-6 months long, immersive, apprenticeship-type programs for experienced sailors looking to get a hand up in the sailing industry, or want to try all different sailing disciplines before deciding their focus. Spend a whole summer, winter or year at Oakcliff. You will get to learn all there is to know about racing, boat maintenance, organization and more from the experts at Oakcliff. Have a gap year, or time off in the winter? Oakcliff sailing does not stop when the snow flies. Join the team in the boat shop learning absolutely everything that it takes to keep our fleets ready to race. Be first in line for winter racing when available, get pro

services.name: Camp
services.desc: Adapted for sailors looking to step into high-performance and Olympic-class sailing, this intensive 10 day camp takes place after College Nationals and is ideal for college sailors, dinghy sailors, recent graduates, and motivated youth sailors who want to explore what it takes to sail and campaign at the Olympic

services.name: Supporter Sailing
services.desc: As a supporter, you have the opportunity to join us for Wednesday night fleet racing, in conjunction with Sagamore Yacht Club. You can also come out on Friday afternoons for coached Supporter Sailing

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Oakcliff accepts trainees with a wide variety of skill levels at a wide range of ages, from absolute beginner sailor to seasoned racer. What we look for is a drive to succeed.
